result:
S1 to S5 are built and committed on `w2/W2-32` (`fd72ad3a` for the code and tests, `e075d67a` for the evidence file). My own unit tests pass, and I stopped there as the CTO asked. One existing test outside my paths now fails because of S2, and it needs a test designer's revision (see `discoveries`).

**Sandbox check (step 0):** (a) the write to `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/.sandbox-trial-DAEO-0pyc` failed (read-only file system) and no file exists; (b) `git hash-object -w` and `git update-index --refresh` both worked. **No `ollama` or `llama-server` process was started by me:** `ps -eo pid,args | grep -iE "[o]llama|[l]lama-server"` shows nothing. My one early `gov retrieve` (sent before the CTO's message) stopped at once with STORE_MISSING, before any embedder started.

- **task:** W2-32 (DAEO-0pyc), engineer, round 1: KPI lines S1 to S5, built to the ticket's interface section (P-W2-32-1, `37cd5e19`).
- **status:** DONE for S1 to S5. S6 to S8 wait for the owner's gaps. The branch merges after measure 2.
- **work_completed:**
  - Survey: `MODEL` was hard-coded. A rebuild already re-embedded when the model or revision changed, but a search never checked the store's model or revision, and the 512-character cut was not recorded.
  - S4 was partly met: `retrieve` caught three error types, but `fusion.search` raised.
  - S5 was not met: `fusion.search` returned at most 30 hits whatever the limit, and a negative limit dropped hits from the end. `retrieve`'s own cut (batches times rounds) was already honoured, so DP-3 is unchanged and no PACKAGES was needed.
  - S1: the pin lives in `governance/project/models.yaml`. Without the file, ADR-0002's pin `ac6da0dfba84` holds. Changing the pin makes the next rebuild drop every vector and embed every chunk again.
  - S2: `MODEL_UNPINNED`, `MODEL_MISMATCH` and `MODEL_NOT_LISTED` come first in the reason text, so they also show in `retrieve` and `gov rebuild`, and again in an `error` field. The cut 512 is in `manifest()`, and stores built before W2-32 report `stale`.
  - S3: `gov.retrieval.learning.record` and `events` write each miss and its regression case under `fixtures/memory-quality/`. That folder is never embedded.
  - S4: `rerank()` reports a reranker that dies after loading (or a loader that fails) as `unavailable`, with the failure named and the order kept. A dead private reranker is dropped, so the next search starts a new one.
  - S5: a limit gives exactly that many distinct hits; an invalid limit raises `ValueError`.
- **files_changed:**
  - New: `src/gov/config/models.py`, `src/gov/retrieval/learning.py`, `tests/unit/retrieval/test_w2_32_{pin,learning,rerank_fusion}.py`, `docs/changes/W2-32-evidence.md`.
  - Changed: `src/gov/retrieval/{semantic,rerank,fusion}.py`.
  - Stand-in digests moved onto the pin (in my paths): `tests/unit/retrieval/test_w2_123_retry.py`, `test_w2_126_retry.py`, `test_w2_126_vector_cache.py`, `tests/unit/semantic/test_semantic.py`.
- **evidence:** `docs/changes/W2-32-evidence.md` has one row per line with the commands. Scratch: `du -sh` 24K and 856 inodes before cleaning; cleaned.
- **tests:**
  - Own tests: 69 passed with `--optin=lifted,breadth`; 80 with `tests/unit/semantic` added.
  - Neighbours: 233 passed and 1 failed in semantic, retrieval and rebuild; 112 passed in retrieve, context, synthesis and validate.
  - Not run, as the CTO ordered: the scoped set from `select_tests.py` and any real-model suite.
  - `test_w2_112_shared_reranker.py` was left out because the sandbox refuses its Unix socket. It fails 18 of 26 on the unchanged base too.
- **discoveries:**
  - `tests/unit/rebuild/test_w2_122_seed.py::test_an_endpoint_now_reporting_another_revision_refuses_the_base` now fails. Its endpoint moves to digest `"b"*64` with no pin for it, so the cold rebuild now fails closed. It needs a test designer to pin that revision in its tree's `models.yaml`.
  - W2-123's acceptance stand-in reports digest `"0"*64`, so its rebuild cases will fail closed under the default pin in the same way. I did not run it.
  - `seed.py` (not in my paths) still compares against the default model, so a configured other model gets a cold rebuild instead of a seed. That is safe, but slower.
  - The worktree has untracked dotfiles (`.bashrc`, `.gitconfig`, `.idea`, …) that are not mine. I left them uncommitted.
- **risks:**
  - Every existing store reports the semantic route `stale` until it is rebuilt once. W2-126's cache makes that rebuild cheap.
  - A search now fails closed when the query embedder (port 11435) reports a different digest than the store was built with. Both servers must list the same digest.
  - Event and case files are still keyword-indexed. A recorded question could take a top-5 lexical slot in the measure. I did not change `lexical.py`, which is W2-13's.
- **lessons:** The interface section arrived mid-build. Reading the ticket's interface before designing would have saved one redesign (event folder, error names).
- **proposed_decisions:**
  - P2: approve the test designer's revisions to `test_w2_122_seed.py`'s re-pin case and to W2-123's stand-in digest (moved onto the pin). Recommended; confidence high.
  - P2: exclude `fixtures/memory-quality/**` from lexical indexing, or measure what it costs. Confidence medium.
  - Whether a bundle limit should bound child hits (DEC-860) is still open. DP-3 is unchanged.
- **unresolved:** The reranker's pin is not configurable yet: a `reranker` key in `models.yaml` is refused as CONFIG_INVALID. `gov accept W2-32` has not been run (its tests are not merged yet).
- **recommended_next_action:** The CTO merges the acceptance tests into `w2/W2-32` so I can run `gov accept W2-32`, runs the scoped set outside the sandbox, and has a test designer revise the two re-pin tests named above.
